svg.title: Separate movement from how it is observed
svg.desc: INHERITED DESIGN. The inherited experiment crosses paired movement states with observation conditions. Drawn skeletons and tracks are illustrative, not measured results.
svg.text: Separate movement from how it is observed
Reuse the parent's crossed families, references and physical-time grid.
Movement contrasts stay within an observation condition. Each camera uses its own projected 2D reference.
